description: Hey, I’m Amir, an MS CS student who builds full stack apps and 3D games. We’re building a 3D lunar south pole mission planner on real LOLA terrain: compare landing sites by sunlight, Earth visibility and comms windows, stand at any site to watch the Sun and Earth cross the horizon, and auto-rank the best landing dates. Looking for: Three.js/frontend, Python/data, and someone strong in design or storytelling for the demo video. Fast, focused, shipping to win.
